what: Rounded-corner photo panels advance by a Splide loop (loop, centered) every 4s over 2s, while the whole strip is tilted −8° and each panel is turned back upright by +8° and 120px down, staggered like stairs. The center panel tilts less at 5° and sinks to 150px, with the photo stepping back to .94x (.3s ease)

options.--fx-drop: Distance the panel drops (via style), default 120px
options.--fx-active-tilt: Tilt of the center panel (via style), default 5deg
options.--fx-active-scale: Center board photo scale (via style), default .94

note: Load Splide 4.1.2 (library/_vendor/splide@4.1.2) first. The part wraps .splide__track in a tilted panel (remove it to revert). To tighten the gap between panels on phones, make gap smaller
